newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-WAIKATO BEAT TARANAKI TO WIN RANFURLY SHIELD.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WAIKATO BEAT TARANAKI TO WIN RANFURLY SHIELD.

text.p: Zealand rugby's coveted Ranfurly Shield on Sunday after
producing a third-quarter scoring spree to beat Taranaki 40-19.
Waikato posted 20 points in 20 minutes to strangle the life
out of Taranaki and quieten the 28,000 Taranaki supporters.
With All Black Matthew Cooper in good kicking form, the
Cooper struck all eight attempts at goal superbly finishing
with exactly half of his side's 40 points from four conversions
Down 10-14 at half time, Waikato upped the tempo towards the
end, netting tries to flanker Scott Miller and fullback Bruce
Waikato - Tries: B. Reihana (2), S. McLeod, S Miller.
Taranaki - Tries: R.Jarman, R.Wheeler. Penalties: D. Lilley
